text_block_list.text:
I utilized my best equation, yet first
place was so
far from my grasp...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Just what am I missing? What went
wrong?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
How can I win? What should I do? My
thoughts
feel so jumbled...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: You can figure this out. I'm sure of it.
Your head's going to burst from overthinking!

text_block_list.text:
How can I win? What should I do? My
thoughts
feel so jumbled...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: You can figure this out. I'm sure of it.
Your head's going to burst from overthinking!

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, but you don't need to lie to
cheer me
up...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I nod firmly to dispel the uneasiness I
see in her
eyes.

You have so much faith in me, and I
know it's not
groundless.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You have always been there to support
me with
your advice. It's always been
that way, and I hope
that continues...
And you know what?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You think my head is swollen like a
balloon?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
My head is of perfectly average size!
And I'm not
overthinking anything! Not
at all! But...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I do place too much weight on
my
calculations.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm always stuck in my thoughts during a
race,
when I should be focusing on the
opponents right
in front of me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Things will be all right. Don't let it get to you.

text_block_list.text: Thank you. My mind feels clearer now.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I won't let you down. I promise!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'll win so I can prove your faith in me
isn't
misplaced!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
